item.title: Columbia Office of Violence Prevention targets two-year collaboration to curb crime
item.description:
The Columbia Office of Violence Prevention believes in two years, collaboration between community-based groups will be strong enough to deter some crimes from happening across the city.

The OVP began operating in Mar. 2025 following a 2023 proposal by Mayor Barbara Buffaloe. The goal of the office is to coordinate the development, implementation and evaluation of prevention and intervention tactics in the city. It works to provide community enrichment programs and ensure discussions about violent trends are being addressed.

Halloween weekend saw some violent crimes in Columbia. Downtown, a 36-year-old woman was shot in the back early Saturday morning. Outside a southside Walmart, a 46-year-old man was shot Sunday night.

The post Columbia Office of Violence Prevention targets two-year collaboration to curb crime appeared first on ABC17NEWS.
